projects.name: Farmacy ERP
projects.description: Pharmacy ERP with an offline-capable point of sale, B2C storefront, FEFO batch inventory, loyalty points, RBAC and four payment gateways.

Designed the PostgreSQL schema and maintain 693 automated tests used as the release acceptance criterion.
